location.before: One high-accuracy browser location attempt; native Android configuration omitted foreground location permissions.
location.after: Coarse/cached position first; one GPS fallback for unavailable or timed-out position. Denial/abort do not retry. Per-attempt watchdog bounds missing WebView callbacks.
location.coordinateTransmission: Unchanged: only the existing consented city lookup providers; no IP fallback, no location tracking.
location.permissions: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION and ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION; only explicit user-triggered WebView request. No background location.

podium.cause: End-aligned cards have content-dependent intrinsic heights
podium.fix: Stretch a common grid row; runner-ups have a 20px top inset. Names and times can wrap without clipping or changing ranks.

validation: No location request during manual city search
APK and AAB inspectors reject version 343+ if foreground permissions are missing
